purpose: Joint observational expansion measurement and sensitivity to unmeasured residual supernova luminosity evolution
primary_data: Dovekie 1820 released corrected distances and total covariance
DESI DR2 13 BAO measurements and full covariance
Planck 2018 full Plik TTTEEE, low ell TT and EE, native lensing
ancestry: Do not multiply Pantheon+, DES-SN5YR and Dovekie: overlapping events and calibration. Do not multiply a Planck-derived sound-horizon prior by the Planck likelihood.
shared_physics: Flat FLRW, GR, CAMB PPF dark energy, adiabatic scalar power law, fixed total neutrino mass 0.06 eV, one massive species, Neff 3.044, standard BBN helium and recombination; rdrag calculated from the same early-universe parameters used for CMB spectra.
CPL_domain: Original intended design: no additional hard w0+wa<0 constraint; record and investigate CAMB domain failures. Implementation finding: CAMB1.6.6 DarkEnergyEqnOfState.validate_params itself rejects w0+wa>0. The initial CMB chain therefore has this implicit support restriction, even without a separately configured prior. Do not describe it as unrestricted CPL. The independent late-geometry fit has no such cut; wider CMB support requires a separately validated theory implementation.
implementation_amendment: Source audit during chain initialization, before posterior conclusions, found the CAMB early-w guard. Original registration is preserved at Git3d585e88. This disclosure does not change or silently reinterpret the sampling likelihood.
luminosity_sensitivity: Baseline assumes zero residual redshift-dependent mean luminosity beyond released corrections.
epsilon log(1+z)/log(2), epsilon uniform [-0.5,0.5] mag; positive epsilon means dimmer standardised SNe at z=1.
Four natural-cubic shape coefficients with independent zero-mean Gaussian sigma 0.1 mag, then 0.3 mag, at z=.1,.4,.8,1.3 and fixedzero at z=0, integrated analytically into the covariance.
These are declared sensitivity priors, not empirically measured host-age corrections. Do not convert uncertain host ages into an added correction without their selection-conditioned joint likelihood.
inference_checks: independent split rank-normalised Rhat <=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS >=400 before numerical interval claims
mock coverage conditional on the assumed released Gaussian covariance
best-fit residual/probe contributions and cosmological sensitivity; no absolute joint p value from nuisance-penalised normalised likelihood constants
reporting: Present-day acceleration, acceleration at any measured epoch, time evolution of q, increasing scale-factor acceleration (jerk sign), and LambdaCDM adequacy are different questions. A posterior compatible with q>=0 is not evidence of deceleration. No Bayes factor is inferred from optimised chi-square.
physical_completion_gate: A full raw-survey measurement additionally needs signed flux and observation operator, event identities, selection and contaminants, calibration and physical host likelihood, trained jointly with validated coverage. The released-distance joint fit does not certify those upstream components.
